roadmap.goal: Finish the story and earn every chapter and named-mission trophy. Do side content as it appears; do not leave story missions sitting in the list.
tips: Play the missions in the order offered — chapter trophies only count story missions.
Finish each named mission when it appears; a first-run story moment cannot be replayed except through mission replay.
Save before the final mission and finish any story-tied side content first.
roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

roadmap.goal: Clear every contact strand and the stranger missions. Five contacts have a final-mission trophy each.
tips: Work one contact strand at a time until its final mission appears.
Strangers are spread across the whole state — check the map for their markers.
Choices add up across the playthrough; keep deciding, do not avoid them.
roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Contacts and strangers

roadmap.goal: Work through the activities: shooting range golds, races, stunts, fishing, arcade, bowling, robberies and the one-off stunts.
tips: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges — they are repeatable, so a bad run costs nothing.
Win 20 different races and a drone race at all 14 locations.
Robberies are repeatable: if an escape fails, try again.
roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Activities and skills

roadmap.goal: Cover the map: explore all 52 areas, meditate at 18 spots, collect card sets, WAiNK at 100 spots, discover 100 vehicles.
tips: Combine this stage with travel: meditate and WAiNK whenever you reach a new area.
Register vehicles in the Scooter Bros app as you discover them.
Launder marked bills through contacts as you earn them; spend in shops as you go.
roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles and exploration

roadmap.goal: Check the in-game completion percentage, finish whatever it lists, and the platinum pops.
tips: 100% completion is the last gold for most players — it is the whole checklist, not one task.
Use this tracker's remaining list against the game's stats screen.
When only the platinum is left, it pops on its own.
roadmap.title: Stage 5 — Cleanup and 100%
